analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price (1,322,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,569,600 KRW) / SMA20 (1,923,850 KRW) / SMA50 (2,168,841 KRW) — indicating short-to-mid term downtrend

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.0 → 31.8) — entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-527,403.241 → -684,242.144) — bearishness persists and worsens, dead cross maintained
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 1,353,816 KRW) — approaching lower band, potential for further decline

· Swing resistance (1,995,000 KRW) — Pivot R1 (2,130,667 KRW) as mid-term resistance

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.42x vs 5-day average) — increased volume during decline, suggesting panic selling
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend) — observing RSI oversold, MACD bearish convergence, and Bollinger band approaching lower limit, hence maintaining a wait-and-see approach for buying
